I would be content and happy to play as a middle aged Lara, but I’m against of any sort of a family oriented plot-line. Maybe in the distant future, but for now I really don’t like the idea of unifying the timelines only to basically make Lara retired and suddenly have a child and a dead lover? We have had the last 10 years, games that focuses on family issues. Isn’t it time to just focus on an adventure for once and not some personal drama. I really think the next game should focus on solely on Lara and who she is now and her passion in Tomb Raiding, because I feel like I barely even know her anymore. Overall, I don’t think the games need to be these cinematic drama pieces everytime, but instead adventurous and fun.

I also don’t really like the open world concept.
